# 📋 Protect drinking water supply

- **Checklist types:** Morning Dominatrix, Evening Dominatrix
- **Area:** Private infrastructure
- **When:** When the Dominatrix determines that the fresh-water supply is too low for showers

## What you need

- 🔧 Camp Shower — Shower area (see the map). Private shower for Treble Makers camp members only.
- 🔧 Out of Service Sign — Private infrastructure area. Reusable sign used to close unsafe or nonfunctional camp equipment.
- 📋 Fill kitchen drinking water dispensers
- 📦 Camp Issue Log — At the Dominatrix station. On-playa log for unresolved task, supply, safety, and service issues. Do not record private incident or health details.

## Ready before normal use

- **🔧 Camp Shower:** The shower is open, clean, empty of personal belongings, and has no leak or standing water.

## Steps

1. Close the camp shower to users.
2. Display 🔧 Out of Service Sign at the shower entrance.
3. Complete 📋 Fill kitchen drinking water dispensers.
4. Record the shower closure and water-service need in 📦 Camp Issue Log.

## PASS when

- The shower is closed and visibly marked out of service.
- Both kitchen drinking-water dispensers are full.
- The water-service need is recorded.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **🔧 Camp Shower:** No personal belonging, hair, trash, mud, visible dirt, leak, puddle, or standing water remains.
- **🔧 Out of Service Sign:** The sign is displayed on closed equipment or returned to its storage place.
- **📦 Camp Issue Log:** Every unresolved operational issue has a current status and next action.

### If an item is not ready

- **🔧 Camp Shower:** Close the shower, display 🔧 Out of Service Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.

## Who to ask

Dominatrix
